name: Sarapin Four
description: Sarapin Four was a planet in the Sarapin system of the Core Worlds. During the Cold War, the Galactic Republic Valor-class cruiser Enkindle retreated to the upper atmosphere of Sarapin Four, but was destroyed by Imperial forces.
